_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every threshold and window used by analysis/build_indicators.py. The engine must read this file, not re-hardcode values.
_meta.note: PRD v3 section 7 says Younes owns thresholds (hot day, frost day, extreme rain day, dry day, reference rainfall) and provides them in this file. Every value not fixed by the PRD is marked placeholder - pending Younes.
_meta.K_WATER_K_SOIL: Intentionally absent: the engine's stress-adjustment constants are Alaa's business (PRD v3 section 6.1, open question 3), not a data threshold.

growing_season.definition: October (year Y-1) to May (year Y), used for growing-season rain and the in-season longest dry spell

grain_filling_window.definition: April to June, used for hot days

late_frost_window.definition: March to April, used for frost days

hot_day_max_temp_c.definition: day counts as hot when Tmax > value

frost_day_min_temp_c.definition: day counts as frost when Tmin < value

extreme_rain_day_mm.definition: day counts as extreme rain when PRECTOTCORR > value

dry_day_mm.definition: day counts as dry when daily rain < value; dry spell = consecutive dry days, broken by wet days AND by missing days (never merged across missing days)

reference_rainfall.method: region's own mean annual rainfall over 1995-2014 (calendar years, POWER)
reference_rainfall.source: PRD v3 glossary defines water stress vs 'the reference rainfall' but does not fix the reference; the 1995-2014 method follows v1 and must be confirmed by Younes/Alaa

water_stress.status: pending Alaa (recent-window choice) - see logs/step1_report.md finding c

trend.agreement_label: both methods agree only if both p < 0.05 and slopes have the same sign; otherwise 'no clear trend'
trend.status: PRD v3 section 6.4 (both methods required); implementation pending Alaa sign-off

soc_classes_g_per_kg.unit: g/kg (0-30 cm, depth-weighted 5:10:15, dg/kg divided by 10)
soc_classes_g_per_kg.status: placeholder - pending Younes (v1 used 10/12/15, frontend used 12/16; this file follows the guide's Low<10 and adds 10-20/20+ bands)

suggested_priorities.soil_need: 1 if SOC low, 0.5 if medium, 0.1 if high
suggested_priorities.rescale: to sum 100, integers, largest-remainder deterministic rounding
suggested_priorities.status: PRD v3 section 6.2 (example rule, 'thresholds set by Younes and Achref')

ndvi.caveat: no cropland mask, 5x5 km patch, 5 years only; do not present a coefficient of variation as reliable
ndvi.status: PRD v3 section 6 (Nice item); mask + QA pending Earthdata access

confidence_rules.rain_hot_frost: compare POWER vs Open-Meteo (ERA5) 30-year means: relative difference <= 10% = high, <= 25% = medium, otherwise low; downgrade one level when more than 5% of the relevant days are missing
confidence_rules.trend: both p < 0.05 = high; exactly one < 0.05 = medium; none = low ('no clear trend')
confidence_rules.soil: at best medium (SoilGrids is a 250 m model estimate, PRD section 6.4)
confidence_rules.ndvi: low (no cropland mask, no QA filter, 5 years)
confidence_rules.missing_day_definition: POWER value <= -999 (i.e. -999) or any Open-Meteo null
confidence_rules.status: rule proposed by Achref in Step 2; pending team review
